	type = country_event
	title = oe_v45_ws.8.title
	desc = oe_v45_ws.8.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v180_columbian_harvest_plague.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		current_year >= 1570
		current_year <= 1725
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v45_little_ice_age
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_8_seen value = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_v45_ws.8.a
		add_gold = -110
		add_research_progress = 8
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_hardy_crops years = 12 mode = replace }
		if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v45_little_ice_age } situation:oe_sit_v45_little_ice_age = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_lia_resilience } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 30 } } change_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience add = 10 } if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_lia_resilience > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 100 } } if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_lia_resilience < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 0 } } } }
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 50
		}
	}

		name = oe_v45_ws.8.b

		add_stability = 4
		if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v45_little_ice_age } situation:oe_sit_v45_little_ice_age = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_lia_resilience } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 30 } } change_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience add = 7 } if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_lia_resilience > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 100 } } if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_lia_resilience < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 0 } } } }
